queries.stock: select count(*) n, count(*) filter(where close is null) null_close, count(*) filter(where pct_chg is null) null_pct, count(*) filter(where amount is null) null_amount from fact_stock_daily where trade_date='2026-09-11'
queries.stock_null_amount: select stock_ts_code,stock_name,close,pre_close,pct_chg,source from fact_stock_daily where trade_date='2026-09-11' and amount is null
queries.sector: select count(*) n,count(*) filter(where pct_chg is null) null_pct,count(*) filter(where amount is null) null_amount,count(*) filter(where diff_ratio is null) null_diff from fact_sector_daily where trade_date='2026-09-11'
queries.l2: select scan_type,count(*) n,count(*) filter(where main_buy_net_wan is null or total_buy_net_wan is null or score is null or pct_change is null) null_core,min(calculated_at) first_calc,max(calculated_at) last_calc from feature_l2_capital_flow_daily where trade_date='2026-09-11' group by scan_type
queries.quant: select count(*) n,count(*) filter(where quant_amount_wan is null or quant_pct_of_big_buy is null or cluster_count is null or order_count is null or pct_change is null) null_core from feature_l2_quant_orders_daily where trade_date='2026-09-11'
queries.ops: select * from ops_pipeline_run_daily where trade_date='2026-09-11' and pipeline='l2-moneyflow' order by step
queries.top100_coverage: with ranked as(select left(stock_ts_code,6) code from fact_stock_daily where trade_date='2026-09-11' and amount is not null order by amount desc limit 100) select count(*) n,count(l.stock_code) scanned from ranked r left join feature_l2_capital_flow_daily l on l.stock_code=r.code and l.trade_date='2026-09-11' and l.scan_type='top100'
queries.pct_diff: select l.scan_type,count(*) n,count(*) filter(where abs(l.pct_change-s.pct_chg)>0.02) mismatches,count(*) filter(where l.pct_change*s.pct_chg<0) opposite_sign from feature_l2_capital_flow_daily l join fact_stock_daily s on left(s.stock_ts_code,6)=l.stock_code and s.trade_date=l.trade_date where l.trade_date='2026-09-11' group by l.scan_type
queries.quant_pct_diff: select count(*) n,count(*) filter(where abs(l.pct_change-s.pct_chg)>0.02) mismatches,count(*) filter(where l.pct_change*s.pct_chg<0) opposite_sign from feature_l2_quant_orders_daily l join fact_stock_daily s on left(s.stock_ts_code,6)=l.stock_code and s.trade_date=l.trade_date where l.trade_date='2026-09-11'
queries.divergence_examples: select l.stock_code,l.stock_name,l.scan_type,l.pct_change as l2_pct,s.pct_chg as daily_pct,l.main_buy_net_wan from feature_l2_capital_flow_daily l join fact_stock_daily s on left(s.stock_ts_code,6)=l.stock_code and s.trade_date=l.trade_date where l.trade_date='2026-09-11' and l.stock_code in ('600584','688801','002790') order by l.stock_code,l.scan_type
queries.freshness: select 'theme_flow' as dataset,max(trade_date) as max_date from fact_theme_flow_daily union all select 'stock',max(trade_date) from fact_stock_daily union all select 'market',max(trade_date) from fact_market_daily union all select 'sector',max(trade_date) from fact_sector_daily
